scope: Isolated native PSO GameCube resident-face texture inspection, synthetic test-color application, rendering and restoration

selection.class_selection: Selected explicitly after read-only comparison of all twelve owned class face banks; not inferred from the character's appearance
selection.head_hair_reference: The editor reference remained the explicitly selected default head/hair; automatic matching of the player's current head/hair was not verified

rendered_evidence.comparison: Human inspection of native before/after/restored screenshots, supported by a head-region color count; whole-screen differences were not used as face proof
rendered_evidence.test_color: Synthetic magenta patch, darkened by native game lighting
rendered_evidence.dark_purple_pixel_rule: R > 1.4*G and B > 1.4*G and R > 35 and B > 30

limits: This proves a native face texture can be changed and restored visibly with test pixels; it does not verify a person's likeness or the quality of a selfie projection.
Windows Dolphin face rendering was not exercised by this native proof.
Other player classes, head/hair combinations and game revisions need their own resident-map selection and validation.
The local test artifact service exercised the worker inspect/apply protocol; this was not an end-to-end production browser session.
This is a temporary RAM texture edit, not a persistent rebuilt-ROM proof.
